description: Milieueffectrapportage (MER) Energietransitie 2022 Alternatief 1 wind is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Dataset ten behoeve van de Milieueffectrapportage (MER) Energietransitie 2022 die op 4 oktober 2022 door Gedeputeerde Staten is vastgesteld. Dit is een plan-m.e.r. behorend bij de Herziening Omgevingsbeleid module Energietransitie die op 14 december 2022 door Provinciale Staten is vastgesteld. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are duurzaamheid, energietransitie, regionale-energie-strategie, windturbine, windturbines. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
